replies.author: Johnnyloans
replies.text:
gosrox

I'm pretty sure this is how every phone works because it is handled by your carrier. After a phone doesn't answer a call, the carrier's voicemail takes over. Voicemail works while the phone is off, so a phone update won't add this feature.

Maybe your carrier can block a specific number for you.

replies.author: gosrox
cyberpholk
replies.text:
i believe that voicemail notification SMS can be coming from your carrier but showing display as coming from the incoming number (SMS is actually intended to be about passing simple network info between the phone and network and text messages got added on after)

your carrier might have options around this.

just checking- are you getting just a notification that says you have a voicemail waiting, or just a message in messages saying it is from the blocked number and that you have a voicemail?

if i'm correct (that is a big if), then to accomplish what you want, you would need to block SMS between phone services and your carrier, but then the phone wouldn't work. so seeing if there is an option with your carrier to not send an sms notification for voicemail would be the thing to do.

i'm speculating though and am more than happy to be incorrect
